note: Example/developer submodule: a sample field type cs_custom_field plus example @FieldHandler/@EntityHandler plugins for Content Sync. No config, UI, Drush or permissions. Cases are grounded in the real plugin ids and the cs_custom_field field type; medium/hard use a field of that type on Article (creatable and inspectable via drush without any sync backend).

evals.prompt: The cms_content_sync_custom_field_example submodule ships a sample field type used to demonstrate a Content Sync field handler. What is the machine name (plugin id) of that field type?
evals.expected_output: The field type id is cs_custom_field (Plugin/Field/FieldType/CustomField, @FieldType id=cs_custom_field), with an accompanying widget and formatter.

evals.prompt: In cms_content_sync_custom_field_example, how does the example CustomFieldHandler tell Content Sync it applies to the cs_custom_field field, and what plugin annotation/base does it use?
evals.expected_output: CustomFieldHandler is a @FieldHandler (id cms_content_sync_custom_field_handler) extending DefaultFieldHandler; its static supports($entity_type,$bundle,$field_name,$field) returns TRUE when $field->getType() is cs_custom_field.

evals.prompt: The example submodule includes an IgnoreFieldHandler. What does it demonstrate and which field does it match?
evals.expected_output: IgnoreFieldHandler (@FieldHandler id cms_content_sync_ignore_field_handler) matches the field named field_ignore_example and returns TRUE from push/pull without transferring any data, i.e. it shows how to exclude a field from syndication.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a field on the Article content type that uses the custom field type provided by cms_content_sync_custom_field_example. Inspect the live field configuration and give the machine name of that field and its field type.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_ccs_known and its type is cs_custom_field (FieldStorageConfig node.field_ccs_known, type cs_custom_field).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, add a field named field_ccs_custom to the Article content type using the custom field type that the cms_content_sync_custom_field_example module provides (cs_custom_field). Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A FieldStorageConfig node.field_ccs_custom of type cs_custom_field exists and is attached to the article bundle (FieldConfig node.article.field_ccs_custom).
